dialogues.zh: 很高兴认识你！（初次见面必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 初次见面黄金法则：听到 Nice to meet you，句尾加 too 秒回！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi! I'm Wu Binbin. Nice to meet you!
dialogue.zh: 你好！我是吴斌斌。很高兴认识你！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Hi! I'm Sarah. Nice to meet you, too!
dialogue.zh: 你好！我是萨拉。我也很高兴认识你！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天愉快！

dialogues.zh: 你好吗？/ 你最近怎么样？（熟人问候）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 熟人见面三连击：How are you? ➔ I'm fine, thank you. ➔ And you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Good morning, Mike! How are you today?
dialogue.zh: 早上好，迈克！你今天好吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm fine, thank you! And you?
dialogue.zh: 我很好，谢谢你！你呢？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天愉快！

dialogues.zh: 谢谢你！— 不用谢 / 别客气。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 礼貌满分口诀：听到 Thank you 别发呆，You're welcome 脱口来！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Here is a birthday gift for you!
dialogue.zh: 这是送给你的生日礼物！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Wow, thank you very much!
dialogue.zh: 哇，非常感谢你！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You're welcome!
dialogue.zh: 不客气！

dialogues.zh: 对不起。— 没关系！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 考场防坑铁律：Thank you ➔ You're welcome；I'm sorry ➔ That's OK!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'm sorry, Miss White. I tripped and dropped the books.
dialogue.zh: 对不起，怀特老师。我绊了一下把书弄掉了。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: That's OK! Let me help you pick them up.
dialogue.zh: 没关系！我来帮你把它们捡起来吧。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you, Miss White.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢您，怀特老师。

dialogues.zh: 劳驾 / 打扰一下 / 请让一让（事前礼貌询问）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 黄金区分：事前打扰问路用 Excuse me；事后做错道歉用 I'm sorry！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, sir. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 劳驾（打扰一下），先生。您能帮帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure! What can I do for you?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以！需要我帮你做什么？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢您！

dialogues.zh: 明天见！（放学道别必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 语序魔法：中文说“明天见”，英文动作放前面说 See you tomorrow！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: School is over! Goodbye, Amy! See you tomorrow!
dialogue.zh: 放学啦！再见，艾米！明天见！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Bye, John! See you tomorrow!
dialogue.zh: 拜拜，约翰！明天见！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天愉快！

dialogues.zh: 我可以进来吗？（敲门进教室/办公室必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 敲门礼貌金句：May I come in? ➔ 老师回答 Come in, please!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Knock, knock! Excuse me, Miss White. May I come in?
dialogue.zh: 咚咚！打扰一下，怀特老师。我可以进来吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, come in, please! Sit down.
dialogue.zh: 可以，请进吧！请坐。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢您！

dialogues.zh: 我可以借用一下你的尺子吗？
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 递东西口语王牌：把东西递给别人说“给你”，要用 Here you are!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me. Can I borrow your ruler?
dialogue.zh: 劳驾，我可以借用你的尺子吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure! Here you are!
dialogue.zh: 当然可以！给你！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你！

dialogues.zh: 您能再说一遍吗？（没听懂时求助必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 课堂救急法宝：没听清就说 Can you say it again? 或 Pardon?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Sorry, Mr Jones. I don't understand. Can you say it again?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，琼斯老师。我没听懂。您能再说一遍吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No problem! Let me say it slowly for you.
dialogue.zh: 没问题！让我慢慢地为你再讲一遍。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 该上课了！（到做某事的时间了）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 必考语法双胞胎：It's time for + 名词 ＝ It's time to + 动词原形！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Listen! The bell is ringing. It's time for English class!
dialogue.zh: 听！上课铃响了。该上英语课啦！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Hurry up! Let's go to the classroom!
dialogue.zh: 快点！我们赶紧去教室吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 我们一起玩吧！（课间邀请小伙伴必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 邀请小伙伴口诀：Let's 后面接动词原形，回答 Good idea!（好主意）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Class is over! Let's play football together on the playground!
dialogue.zh: 下课啦！我们一起去操场上踢足球吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Great! That's a good idea! Let's go!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！那真是个好主意！我们走吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 这个用英语怎么说？（随时学新词必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 答句防错口诀：问句用 What's this/that，答句一律用 It's a/an...！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, Miss White. What's this in English?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，怀特老师。这个用英语怎么说呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's a notebook. N-O-T-E-B-O-O-K, notebook!
dialogue.zh: 它是一个笔记本。N-O-T-E-B-O-O-K，笔记本！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 你想吃/喝点什么？（点餐与待客必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 点餐常用答法：听到 What would you like?，最常用的回答是 I'd like some...；直接说 “Some noodles, please.” 也完全正确，不必拘泥一种。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Welcome! What would you like to eat today?
dialogue.zh: 欢迎光临！你今天想吃点什么？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'd like some beef noodles and orange juice, please!
dialogue.zh: 请给我来一份牛肉面和一杯橙汁！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK, just a moment, please.
dialogue.zh: 好的，请稍等。

dialogues.zh: 请随便吃！/ 别客气自己夹菜！（热情待客必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 防望文生义王牌：餐桌上的 Help yourself! 意思是“请随便吃，别客气”！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Dinner's ready! Help yourself to some chicken and fruit!
dialogue.zh: 晚饭准备好啦！请随便吃点鸡肉和水果，别客气！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thank you! Everything looks so delicious!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢阿姨！所有菜看起来都太美味了！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. It tastes good.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，真好吃。

dialogues.en: Can I have some water, please?
dialogues.zh: 请给我一些水好吗？（礼貌索要食物饮品）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 语法必考细节：Can I have some...? 和 Would you like some...? 疑问句也用 some！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Mum, I'm thirsty. Can I have some water, please?
dialogue.zh: 妈妈，我口渴了。请给我一些水喝好吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Of course! Here you are. Drink slowly.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以！给你。慢点喝哦。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you, Mum!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢妈妈！

dialogues.zh: 还要再来一点吗？— 不用了谢谢，我吃饱了。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 礼貌婉拒金句：Would you like...? 想要说 Yes, please；不要说 No, thank you!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Would you like some more soup and rice, Sam?
dialogue.zh: 山姆，你还要再来点汤和米饭吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, thank you, Grandma! I'm full. It tastes delicious!
dialogue.zh: 不用了，谢谢奶奶！我吃饱啦。饭菜太美味了！

dialogues.zh: 你最喜欢的食物是什么？
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 万能提问模板：What's your favourite + 名词（food/colour/animal）?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Sarah, what's your favourite food?
dialogue.zh: 萨拉，你最喜欢的食物是什么？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: My favourite food is salad. It's healthy and fresh!
dialogue.zh: 我最喜欢的食物是沙拉。它既健康又新鲜！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Salad is healthy! I like it too.
dialogue.zh: 沙拉很健康！我也喜欢！

dialogues.zh: 祝你生日快乐！（派对祝福必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 防闹笑话铁律：听到 Happy birthday! 回答 Thank you!（千万别说 You too）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Happy birthday, Sam! Make a wish and blow out the candles!
dialogue.zh: 祝你生日快乐，山姆！许个愿吹蜡烛吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thank you so much! Let's eat the birthday cake together!
dialogue.zh: 太感谢你们啦！我们一起吃生日蛋糕吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Great! Let's eat!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我们一起吃吧！

dialogues.zh: 需要我帮您吗？/ 您想买点什么？（售货员迎客必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 购物场景第一句：售货员说 Can I help you? ➔ 顾客答 Yes, please!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Welcome to our clothes shop! Can I help you?
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到我们的服装店！您想买点什么？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, please! I want to buy a pretty dress for the party.
dialogue.zh: 好的，麻烦您！我想为派对买一条漂亮的连衣裙。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.zh: 这个多少钱？（询问价格必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 问价铁律：单数 How much is it? (It's...)；复数 How much are they? (They're...)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I like this blue schoolbag! How much is it?
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢这个蓝色的书包！它多少钱呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's on sale today! It's only thirty-five yuan.
dialogue.zh: 今天正在特价促销！只要三十五元。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.zh: 我可以试穿一下吗？（买衣服鞋子必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 夹心饼干法则：代词 it / them 必须夹在 try 和 on 中间（try it on）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This yellow coat is nice. Can I try it on?
dialogue.zh: 这件黄色外套真好看。我可以试穿一下吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Of course! Look in the mirror—it fits you very well!
dialogue.zh: 当然可以！照镜子看看——它非常适合你！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.zh: 我买下它了！（决定购买时最地道表达）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 地道口语地道考：在商店拍板说“这件我买了！”，要用 I'll take it!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This storybook is so interesting and cheap. I'll take it!
dialogue.zh: 这本故事书又有趣又便宜。我买下它了！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Great! That will be fifteen yuan, please.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！一共是十五元。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.en: Excuse me, where is the library?
dialogues.zh: 劳驾，请问图书馆在哪里？（问路必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 问路礼貌黄金公式：Excuse me + Where is the + 场所名称?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, where is the city library?
dialogue.zh: 劳驾，请问市图书馆在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's over there! It's just next to the post office.
dialogue.zh: 就在那边！它紧挨着邮局。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.zh: 一直往前走，然后向左转。（指路必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 指路三大黄金口令：Go straight（直走）· Turn left（左转）· Turn right（右转）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how can I get to the science museum?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，请问我怎么去科学博物馆？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Go straight for five minutes, and then turn left at the hospital!
dialogue.zh: 一直往前走五分钟，然后在医院那里向左转就到啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.en: How do you come to school?
dialogues.zh: 你是怎么来上学的？（询问交通方式必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 必考介词铁律：乘车乘船用 by + 交通工具（不加 the）；步行用 on foot！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi, Amy! How do you come to school every day?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，艾米！你每天是怎么来上学的呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: My home is near, so I usually come on foot. What about you?
dialogue.zh: 我家很近，所以我通常步行来。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I come by bus!
dialogue.zh: 我坐公交车来！

dialogues.zh: 祝你玩得开心！/ 旅途愉快！（送别出行祝福）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 祝福分场合：Have a good time! ＝ Have fun!（玩得开心，通用）；Have a nice trip! 只送要出门旅行的人（trip＝旅行）。去公园野餐用前两句，不要用 trip 版。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We are going to the nature park for a picnic today!
dialogue.zh: 我们今天要去自然公园野餐啦！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Wow, sounds great! Have a good time!
dialogue.zh: 哇，听起来太棒了！祝你们玩得开心！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你！

dialogues.zh: 你怎么了？/ 哪里不舒服？（关心生病或难过的同学）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 看病关心双子星：What's wrong with you? ＝ What's the matter (with you)?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Come and sit down, John. What's wrong with you?
dialogue.zh: 过来坐下吧，约翰。你怎么了（哪里不舒服）？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I feel cold and I have a bad headache, Doctor.
dialogue.zh: 医生，我觉得很冷，而且头很疼。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Take some medicine and have a good rest.
dialogue.zh: 吃点药，好好休息一下。

dialogues.en: Take some medicine and drink warm water.
dialogues.zh: 吃点药，多喝温水。（医嘱与健康建议必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 考场防错金律：“吃药”在英语里必须说 take medicine，千万别说 eat medicine！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You have a cold. Take some medicine, drink warm water and have a good rest!
dialogue.zh: 你感冒了。吃点药、多喝温水，再好好休息一下！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, I will. Thank you very much, Doctor!
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。非常感谢您，医生！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You're welcome! Take care!
dialogue.zh: 不客气！多保重！

dialogues.en: Don't worry! I can help you.
dialogues.zh: 别担心！我可以帮你。（安慰与互助必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 安慰朋友暖心金句：Don't worry! (动词前加 Don't) / Don't be sad! (形容词前加 Don't be)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Oh no! This English puzzle is too hard. I'm so worried.
dialogue.zh: 哎呀！这道英语字谜太难了。我好发愁呀。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Don't worry, Sarah! Let's work together. I can help you!
dialogue.zh: 别担心，萨拉！我们一起来做，我可以帮你！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你！

dialogues.en: Cheer up! You can do it!
dialogues.zh: 振作起来（加油）！你能行的！（鼓励伙伴必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 正能量加油三剑客：Cheer up!（振作起来）· Come on!（加油）· You can do it!（你能行的）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I didn't pass the basketball test today. I feel so sad.
dialogue.zh: 我今天篮球测试没通过，我感觉好难过。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Cheer up, Mike! Practice makes perfect. You can do it next time!
dialogue.zh: 振作起来，迈克！熟能生巧，下次你一定能行的！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.zh: 这太贵了！（评价价格与砍价必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 一词多义巧区分：too 放句尾是“也”，放形容词前是“太…”（too expensive 太贵了）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How much is this red scarf?
dialogue.zh: 这条红围巾多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's two hundred yuan.
dialogue.zh: 两百元。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That's too expensive. How about the blue one?
dialogue.zh: 那太贵了。蓝色的那条呢？

dialogues.zh: 你穿多大尺码的鞋？（买鞋与比较级必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 size 38 是一个「标签」：先说类别 size（尺码），再说数字 38，整块读 size thirty-eight。Page 10、Unit 1 也是同款标签（先类别、后编号）。中文标签是“38 码”（数字在前），顺序正好相反——背标签，别套语序。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Mike, what size are your shoes?
dialogue.zh: 迈克，你穿多大尺码的鞋呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: My shoes are size 38. Your feet are smaller than mine!
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋是38码。你的脚比我的小哦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.en: Stop and wait at a red light!
dialogues.zh: 红灯停，等一等！（交通安全规则必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 交通规则必背三剑客：Red(Stop & wait) · Yellow(Slow down) · Green(Go)!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hurry up! The bus is coming! Let's run across the street!
dialogue.zh: 快点！公交车来了！我们跑过马路吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Wait! Don't go at the red light! We must stop and wait at a red light!
dialogue.zh: 等等！别闯红灯！红灯时我们必须停下来等待！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.zh: 它离这儿远吗？（问距离必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 介词搭配细节：far from here（离这儿远，有 from）↔ near here（在这附近，无 from）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is the bookstore far from here?
dialogue.zh: 劳驾，请问书店离这儿远吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, it's not far! Walk straight for three minutes and you'll see it.
dialogue.zh: 不，一点也不远！直走三分钟你就能看到它啦。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.zh: 你感觉怎么样？（询问心情与身体感受）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 感官系动词口诀：feel / look / sound / taste 后面直接跟形容词！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You took a rest, Amy. How do you feel now?
dialogue.zh: 艾米，你休息了一会儿，现在感觉怎么样啦？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I feel much better now, Mum! Let's go to the park!
dialogue.zh: 妈妈，我现在感觉好多啦！我们去公园吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Good! I'm so glad.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我真高兴。

dialogues.zh: 多么棒的一天啊！（感叹句必会口语）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 感叹句秒杀口诀：中心词是名词用 What (What a great day!)；是形容词用 How (How nice!)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The rain stopped and look at the big rainbow! What a great day!
dialogue.zh: 雨停了，快看天上的大彩虹！多么棒的一天啊！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yeah! How beautiful! Let's take a picture together!
dialogue.zh: 是呀！太美啦！我们一起拍张照吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.zh: 早上好！（清晨见面问候）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 清晨问候金律：上午12点前见面互道 Good morning!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Good morning, Miss White!
dialogue.zh: 早上好，怀特老师！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good morning, Binbin! Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 早上好，斌斌！祝你今天愉快！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天愉快！

dialogues.zh: 下午好！（午后见面问候）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 下午问候金律：中午12点到傍晚6点之间见面说 Good afternoon!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Good afternoon, Sarah!
dialogue.zh: 下午好，萨拉！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good afternoon, Mike! Let's go to the library.
dialogue.zh: 下午好，迈克！我们去图书馆吧。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天愉快！

dialogues.zh: 晚安！做个好梦！（睡前道别必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 考场防坑：晚上见面打招呼用 Good evening；准备睡觉道别才用 Good night!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: It's 9 o'clock. Good night, Mum!
dialogue.zh: 九点啦。妈妈晚安！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good night, dear! Sweet dreams!
dialogue.zh: 晚安，亲爱的！做个好梦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Good night!
dialogue.zh: 晚安！

dialogues.en: How is it going? — Pretty good!
dialogues.zh: 最近进展怎么样？— 挺好的！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 地道口语升级：用 How's it going? 问近况，回答 Pretty good! / Great!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hey, John! How is it going?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，约翰！最近怎么样呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Pretty good! I learned a new English song!
dialogue.zh: 挺好的！我学会了一首新英文歌！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have a nice day!
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天愉快！

dialogues.zh: 您先请！（进门/上下楼梯礼让必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 礼貌绅士金句：进门让别人先走说 After you!（字面：跟在您后面＝您先请）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: After you, Miss White!
dialogue.zh: 怀特老师，您先请！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Oh, thank you! What a polite boy!
dialogue.zh: 噢，谢谢你！真是个有礼貌的男孩！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You're welcome!
dialogue.zh: 不客气！

dialogues.zh: 欢迎来到我们学校！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 欢迎句型铁律：Welcome to + 名词地点（Welcome to China/our school），但 Welcome home 不加 to！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Welcome to our school! Let me show you around.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎来到我们学校！让我带您四处参观一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thank you! Your school is so big and beautiful!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你！你们的学校又大又漂亮！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You're welcome!
dialogue.zh: 不客气！

dialogues.zh: 它怎么拼写？（问单词拼写必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 拼写提问双子星：How do you spell it? ＝ Can you spell it, please?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: It's an apple. How do you spell "apple"?
dialogue.zh: 它是一个苹果。你怎样拼写“apple”？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: A-P-P-L-E, apple!
dialogue.zh: A-P-P-L-E，苹果！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 请举手！（课堂发言规则）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 课堂指令反义词对：Put up your hand (举手) ↔ Put down your hand (把手放下)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Who knows the answer? Put up your hand, please!
dialogue.zh: 谁知道答案？请举起你的手！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Me, Mr Li! I know the answer!
dialogue.zh: 我，李老师！我知道答案！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 把书翻到第10页。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 编号语序铁律：第10页说 Page 10，第1单元说 Unit 1（名词在前，数字在后，首字母常大写）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Class, please open your books to page ten!
dialogue.zh: 同学们，请把书翻到第10页！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, Miss White! We are ready!
dialogue.zh: 好的，怀特老师！我们准备好啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 这是谁的书？（失物招领必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 区分同音双胞胎：Whose（谁的，问归属）vs Who's = Who is（是谁，问身份）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Whose storybook is this on the teacher's desk?
dialogue.zh: 讲台上这本故事书是谁的呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Oh, it's mine! Thank you, Miss White!
dialogue.zh: 噢，它是我的！谢谢您，怀特老师！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 保持你的课桌整洁！（班规礼仪）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 祈使句黄金结构：Keep + 名词 + 形容词（Keep your desk clean / Keep the room quiet）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Please keep your desk clean and tidy, Tom.
dialogue.zh: 汤姆，请保持你的课桌干净整洁。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK! I will put my books in my schoolbag now.
dialogue.zh: 好的！我现在就把书放进书包里。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 在图书馆里要安静学习！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 形容词与副词分工：Be quiet!（be动词后用形容词）↔ Work quietly!（实义动词后用副词 -ly）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Shh! Talk quietly and work quietly in the library.
dialogue.zh: 嘘！在图书馆里请小声说话、安静学习。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sorry! I will read quietly.
dialogue.zh: 对不起！我会安安静静地看书的。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.zh: 该起床啦！（早晨叫醒必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 早晨作息三部曲：wake up (醒来) ➔ get up (起床) ➔ wash my face (洗脸)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Wake up, Sam! It's 7 o'clock. Time to get up!
dialogue.zh: 醒醒，山姆！七点钟啦，该起床了！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, Mum! I'm getting up right now.
dialogue.zh: 好的，妈妈！我马上就起来。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I see.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我知道了。

dialogues.zh: 我的钥匙在哪里？（找东西必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 单复数严格一致：keys / shoes / glasses 是复数，提问必须用 Where are...，回答用 They are...！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Where are my keys? Are they on the table?
dialogue.zh: 我的钥匙在哪里？它们在桌子上吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, they aren't. Look! They are on the fridge!
dialogue.zh: 不，不在。看！它们在冰箱上面呢！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.zh: 你能铺一下床吗？（做家务必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 家务高频搭配：make the bed (铺床) · sweep the floor (扫地) · wash the dishes (洗碗)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you make the bed by yourself, Mike?
dialogue.zh: 迈克，你能自己铺床整理被子吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I can! I make my bed every morning.
dialogue.zh: 我能行！我每天早上都自己铺床。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.en: Let me help you sweep the floor.
dialogues.zh: 让我帮您扫地吧！（主动分担家务）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 主动帮忙黄金句：Let me help you + 动词原形（clean the room / wash the dishes）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Mum, you look tired. Let me help you sweep the floor!
dialogue.zh: 妈妈，您看起来累了。让我帮您扫地吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thank you, Chen Jie! You are so helpful at home!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你，陈杰！你在家里真是太能干、太乐于助人了！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.zh: 请把灯打开。（家电开关必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 标准搭配：带电的开关用 Turn on / Turn off（开灯、开电视、开风扇）；Open / Close 用在门、窗、书本上。这是英语的标准说法，考试也按这个判——记住“电器用 turn”。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: It's getting dark. Turn on the light, please.
dialogue.zh: 天变黑了。请把电灯打开吧。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, Dad! Now the study is bright.
dialogue.zh: 好的，爸爸！现在书房亮堂堂的了。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Good. Now you can do your homework.
dialogue.zh: 好。现在你可以写作业了。

dialogues.en: Take off your shoes at the door.
dialogues.zh: 进门请脱鞋，换上拖鞋。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 穿脱反义词王牌：Put on (穿上/戴上) ↔ Take off (脱下/摘下；飞机起飞也叫 take off)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Welcome home! Please take off your dirty shoes.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎回家！请把脏鞋子脱下来。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, Mum! I'll put on my clean slippers.
dialogue.zh: 好的，妈妈！我这就换上干净的拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.zh: 饭前要洗手！（卫生好习惯）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 时间先后介词对：before meals (饭前) ↔ after school (放学后)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Dinner is ready! Wash your hands before meals, Sam.
dialogue.zh: 晚饭好啦！山姆，饭前要先洗手哦。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Look, Mum! My hands are clean now!
dialogue.zh: 看，妈妈！我的双手现在洗干净啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.en: What are you doing? — I'm reading.
dialogues.zh: 你正在干什么？— 我正在看书。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 现在进行时问答铁律：问句 What are you doing? ➔ 答句必须配 am/is/are + V-ing！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi, Amy! What are you doing in the study?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，艾米！你正在书房里干什么呢？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm reading a very interesting storybook!
dialogue.zh: 我正在读一本非常有趣的故事书！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.en: I usually do my homework at 5:00.
dialogues.zh: 我通常五点钟做家庭作业。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 做作业固定搭配：do my homework（homework 是不可数名词，绝不能加 a 或 s）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: When do you do your homework after school?
dialogue.zh: 放学后你什么时候做家庭作业呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I usually do my homework at five o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 我通常在五点钟做家庭作业。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.zh: 我现在可以看电视吗？
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 四个“看”黄金分工：watch TV/games(看动态屏幕) · read books(看文字) · look at(盯住看) · see a film(看电影)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Mum, I finished my homework. May I watch TV now?
dialogue.zh: 妈妈，我写完作业啦。我现在可以看电视吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, you may! But only for twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 可以的！但只能看二十分钟哦。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.zh: 你打扫你的房间了吗？（过去时问答）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 一般过去时问答：Did you + 动词原形...? ➔ Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Did you clean your room this morning, Sarah?
dialogue.zh: 萨拉，你今天早上打扫房间了吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I did! And I also washed my clothes!
dialogue.zh: 是的，我打扫了！而且我还洗了我的衣服呢！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.zh: 请把你的玩具收拾好！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 收拾整理短语王：put away your toys/books（把玩具/书本收好放回原位）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Time for bed! Please put away your toys, Jim.
dialogue.zh: 该睡觉啦！吉姆，请把你的玩具收拾好放回原处。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, Dad! I'll put them in the toy box.
dialogue.zh: 好的，爸爸！我这就把它们放进玩具箱里。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I will.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我会的。

dialogues.zh: 请把勺子递给我。（餐桌求助必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 餐桌递物黄金句：Pass me the + 餐具 (chopsticks / fork / knife / spoon), please!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Dad, pass me the spoon, please. I want some soup.
dialogue.zh: 爸爸，请把勺子递给我。我想喝点汤。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure! Here you are. Be careful, the soup is hot!
dialogue.zh: 当然可以！给你。小心点，汤很烫哦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. It tastes good.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，真好吃。

dialogues.zh: 我会使用筷子！（中西餐具交际）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 餐具复数铁律：chopsticks（筷子）永远用复数；刀叉常成套说 a knife and fork！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Would you like a knife and fork for the noodles?
dialogue.zh: 吃面条你需要一副刀叉吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, thanks! I can use chopsticks very well!
dialogue.zh: 不用了，谢谢！我很会用筷子！

dialogues.en: What would you like to drink?
dialogues.zh: 你想喝点什么？（点饮品必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 认杯子，不认水温：带把手的是 cup（a cup of tea），透明玻璃杯是 glass（a glass of juice）。热水可以装进 glass（a glass of hot water），果汁也可以倒进 cup——名字跟着杯子走，不跟水温走。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What would you like to drink, Sarah?
dialogue.zh: 萨拉，你想喝点什么饮品？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'd like a glass of orange juice, please!
dialogue.zh: 请给我来一杯橙汁！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK, here you are.
dialogue.zh: 好的，给你。

dialogues.zh: 它尝起来太美味了！（夸赞美食必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 餐桌夸菜三连击：It looks nice! (色) · It smells good! (香) · It tastes delicious! (味)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Try this strawberry cake! How does it taste?
dialogue.zh: 尝尝这块草莓蛋糕吧！味道怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Mmm, it tastes so sweet and delicious!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，它尝起来又甜又美味！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. It tastes good.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，真好吃。

dialogues.en: May I have the bill, please?
dialogues.zh: 请帮我结账（买单）好吗？（餐厅结账）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 餐厅全流程口语：Order (点餐: What would you like?) ➔ Enjoy (用餐: Help yourself!) ➔ Pay (结账: May I have the bill?)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, waiter! May I have the bill, please?
dialogue.zh: 劳驾，服务员！请帮我结账买单好吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure! It's sixty-eight yuan in total.
dialogue.zh: 好的！一共是六十八元。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. It tastes good.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，真好吃。

dialogues.zh: 干杯！新年快乐！（节日聚餐祝福）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 The same to you! 是一面“镜子”：只对你我都适用的祝福有效（Happy New Year、Have a nice weekend），对方照过来，你原样照回去。⚠️ 镜子照不出没发出的祝福：邀请、感谢、只属于对方的生日，都不能用它回应。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Cheers! Happy New Year, everyone!
dialogue.zh: 干杯！祝大家新年快乐！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Cheers! The same to you!
dialogue.zh: 干杯！也同样祝福你（同乐）！

dialogues.zh: 这双鞋多少钱？（复数商品问价）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 单复数问价对照：How much is this coat? (It's...) ↔ How much are these shoes? (They're...)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me. How much are these white shoes?
dialogue.zh: 劳驾，请问这双白色运动鞋多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: They are eighty yuan. Would you like to try them on?
dialogue.zh: 它们八十元。你想试穿一下吗？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.en: Do you have a smaller one?
dialogues.zh: 请问有小一号的吗？（换尺码必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 购物比较级活用：too big ➔ a smaller one · too small ➔ a bigger one · too expensive ➔ a cheaper one！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This T-shirt is too big for me. Do you have a smaller one?
dialogue.zh: 这件T恤我穿太大了。请问有小一点的吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes! Here is Size S. Try this one, please.
dialogue.zh: 有的！这是小号（S码）。请试试这件吧。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.zh: 您想要什么颜色的？（挑颜色必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 购物三连问：What can I do for you? (买什么) ➔ What colour...? (什么颜色) ➔ What size...? (什么尺码)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We have red, yellow and blue caps. What colour would you like?
dialogue.zh: 我们有红、黄、蓝三色棒球帽。你想要什么颜色的？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'd like the blue one, please. Blue is my favourite colour!
dialogue.zh: 请给我拿那顶蓝色的。蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.zh: 我只是随便看看，谢谢。（逛街婉拒导购）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 逛街实用口语：不想被店员一直跟着推销时，微笑说 I'm just looking, thank you!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Good afternoon! Can I help you?
dialogue.zh: 下午好！需要我帮您挑点什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm just looking, thank you!
dialogue.zh: 我先随便看看，谢谢您！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.zh: 它们今天正在打折促销！（特价优惠）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 短语黄金区分：on sale = 打折促销中（便宜划算！） ↔ Half price = 半价！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Look at these fresh strawberries! They are on sale today!
dialogue.zh: 快看这些新鲜的草莓！它们今天正在打折特卖呢！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Wow, great! Let's buy two boxes!
dialogue.zh: 哇，太划算了！我们买两盒吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.zh: 这是找您的零钱。（收银结账必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 熟词生义必考：change 除了“变化”，在购物场景中专指“找回的零钱”（Keep the change 不用找零了）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Here is twenty yuan for the notebook.
dialogue.zh: 这是买笔记本的二十元钱。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thank you! It's fifteen yuan, and here is your five yuan change.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！笔记本十五元，这是找您的五元零钱。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogues.en: How can I get to the hospital?
dialogues.zh: 我怎么去医院？（问路线必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 问路三大句型：Where is...? (在哪) · How can I get to...? (怎么去) · Which bus goes to...? (坐哪路车)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how can I get to the People's Hospital?
dialogue.zh: 劳驾，请问我怎么去人民医院？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Take the No. 12 bus and get off at the hospital stop.
dialogue.zh: 乘坐12路公交车，在医院站下车就到啦。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.en: Turn right at the first crossing.
dialogues.zh: 在第一个十字路口向右转。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 指路介词铁律：在十字路口/医院/书店拐弯，小地点定位一律用介词 at（turn right at the...）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Is the bookstore near here?
dialogue.zh: 请问书店在这附近吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes! Go straight and turn right at the first crossing.
dialogue.zh: 是的！直走，然后在第一个十字路口向右转。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.en: Take the No. 5 bus over there.
dialogues.zh: 去那边乘坐5路公交车。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 考场高频转换：You can take a bus there. ＝ You can go there by bus.（take 是动词，by 是介词）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can I go to the science museum on foot?
dialogue.zh: 我可以步行去科学博物馆吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's a bit far. You can take the No. 5 bus over there.
dialogue.zh: 稍微有点远。你可以去那边乘坐5路公交车。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.en: Get on at the Cinema Stop.
dialogues.zh: 在电影院站上车，在公园站下车。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 上下车反义词对：get on the bus/train/subway (上车) ↔ get off (下车)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How can we get to the nature park by subway?
dialogue.zh: 我们怎么坐地铁去自然公园呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Get on at the Cinema Stop, and get off at the Park Stop!
dialogue.zh: 在电影院站上车，然后在公园站下车！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.en: Don't forget to wear your helmet!
dialogues.zh: 骑车别忘了戴好安全头盔！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 安全出行必背：People on bikes must wear a helmet!（骑自行车的人必须戴头盔）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let's ride bikes in the park, Dad!
dialogue.zh: 爸爸，我们在公园里骑自行车吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Great! Don't forget to wear your helmet first!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！不过别忘了先戴好你的安全头盔！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.en: How long does it take? — Ten minutes.
dialogues.zh: 需要花多长时间？— 十分钟。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 How 疑问词组辨析：How far (问距离多远) ↔ How long (问时间多久)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How long does it take to get to the zoo by bus?
dialogue.zh: 坐公交车去动物园需要花多长时间？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It takes about ten minutes. Very fast!
dialogue.zh: 大约需要十分钟。非常快！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。

dialogues.zh: 张开嘴说“啊——”。（看病检查必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 看病常用身体不适：a headache (头疼) · a toothache (牙疼) · a stomachache (肚子疼) · a sore throat (嗓子疼)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I have a sore throat, Doctor.
dialogue.zh: 医生，我嗓子疼。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Let me see. Open your mouth wide and say "Ah".
dialogue.zh: 让我看看。把嘴巴张大，说“啊——”。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. I'll have a rest.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，我会休息。

dialogues.zh: 你应该去看医生。（健康建议必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 提建议黄金情态动词：You should + 动词原形（see a doctor / wear warm clothes / take a rest）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I feel dizzy and I have a fever.
dialogue.zh: 我觉得头晕，而且发烧了。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Oh dear! You should see a doctor right now!
dialogue.zh: 哎呀！你应该立刻去看医生！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. I'll have a rest.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，我会休息。

dialogues.en: Take a deep breath and count to ten.
dialogues.zh: 深呼吸，然后数到十。（平复情绪必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 六年级核心情绪管理金句：If you feel angry, you should take a deep breath and count to ten!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Mum, my little brother broke my toy car. I'm so angry!
dialogue.zh: 妈妈，小弟弟弄坏了我的玩具车。我好生气呀！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Calm down, dear. Take a deep breath and count to ten.
dialogue.zh: 冷静下来，亲爱的。深呼吸一下，然后从一数到十。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. I'll have a rest.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，我会休息。

dialogues.en: Don't be afraid! I'm here with you.
dialogues.zh: 别害怕！有我陪着你呢。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 考场必考易错点：afraid / sad / angry / worried 都是形容词，说“别害怕/别难过”必须加 be：Don't be afraid/sad!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Listen to the thunder! I'm a little afraid, Mum.
dialogue.zh: 听那雷声！妈妈，我有点害怕。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Don't be afraid! I'm right here with you.
dialogue.zh: 别害怕！妈妈一直在这儿陪着你呢。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you. I'll have a rest.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，我会休息。

dialogues.en: Have a good rest and get well soon!
dialogues.zh: 好好休息，祝你早日康复！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 探病祝福王牌：Get well soon!（祝你早日康复！这里的 well 是形容词“身体健康的”）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Here are some apples and flowers for you. Have a good rest and get well soon!
dialogue.zh: 这是给你带的一些苹果和鲜花。好好休息，祝你早日康复！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thank you so much, Mike! I feel much happier now!
dialogue.zh: 太感谢你了，迈克！我现在心情好多了！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You're welcome! Take care!
dialogue.zh: 不客气！多保重！

dialogues.en: Why are you so happy today?
dialogues.zh: 你今天为什么这么开心呀？
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 Why 是来要原因的：回答时先把原因递出去，最常用的开头是 Because...。递原因不止一种姿势——记住“要给原因”，不是“永远用某个词开头”（考场造句用 Because 开头最稳）。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Why are you so happy today, Chen Jie?
dialogue.zh: 陈杰，你今天为什么这么开心呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Because my mum bought me a cute puppy! And my birthday is coming!
dialogue.zh: 因为我妈妈给我买了一只可爱的小狗！而且我的生日快到啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Wow! How lucky you are!
dialogue.zh: 哇！你真幸运！

dialogues.en: Hello! This is Wu Binbin speaking.
dialogues.zh: 喂，你好！我是吴斌斌。（打电话自报家门）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 电话用语头号铁律：电话里“我是…”用 This is...；“你是谁？”用 Who's that?（绝不用 I am / Who are you）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello! This is Wu Binbin speaking. May I speak to Sarah?
dialogue.zh: 喂，你好！我是吴斌斌。请问我可以和萨拉通话吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Hi, Binbin! This is Sarah speaking!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，斌斌！我就是萨拉！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi, Sarah! Are you free this afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，萨拉！你今天下午有空吗？

dialogues.en: May I speak to Tom, please?
dialogues.zh: 请问我可以找汤姆接电话吗？
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 打电话找人三步曲：May I speak to...? ➔ Hold on, please (请稍等) ➔ This is... speaking (我就是)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello, Auntie! May I speak to Tom, please?
dialogue.zh: 阿姨您好！请问我可以和汤姆通电话吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure! Hold on, please. He is in his bedroom.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以！请稍等别挂断，他在卧室里呢。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK, thank you!
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢您！

dialogues.zh: 请稍等（别挂断电话）。— 谢谢！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 电话等待双子星：Hold on, please! ＝ Wait a moment / minute, please!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello! Is Amy at home? May I speak to her?
dialogue.zh: 您好！请问艾米在家吗？我可以找她接电话吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, she's cleaning her room. Hold on, please!
dialogue.zh: 在的，她正在打扫房间。请稍等一下，别挂断哦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK, thank you!
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢！

dialogues.zh: 你叫什么名字？— 我叫……
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 姓名问答双表达：My name is Sarah. ＝ I am Sarah.（注意缩写 What's = What is, name's = name is）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi! I'm new here. What's your name?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我是新来的。你叫什么名字呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: My name's Chen Jie. Let's be good friends!
dialogue.zh: 我的名字叫陈杰。我们做个好朋友吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you!
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你！

dialogues.en: Where are you from? — I'm from China.
dialogues.zh: 你来自哪里？— 我来自中国。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 国籍必背缩写：China (中国) · the UK (英国) · the USA (美国) · Canada (加拿大) · Australia (澳大利亚)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi, Mike! Where are you from?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，迈克！你是哪里人（来自哪里）呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm from Canada. What about you?
dialogue.zh: 我来自加拿大。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'm from China! Nice to meet you!
dialogue.zh: 我来自中国！很高兴认识你！

dialogues.en: How old are you? — I'm ten years old.
dialogues.zh: 你几岁了？— 我十岁了。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 年龄表达方式：可以说 I'm ten. 也可以说完整版 I'm ten years old.（绝不能只说 I'm ten years ❌）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Happy birthday, Sam! How old are you now?
dialogue.zh: 祝你生日快乐，山姆！你现在几岁啦？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thank you! I'm ten years old today!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你！我今天满十岁啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have a great day!
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天过得愉快！

dialogues.zh: 你的业余爱好是什么？（交友必聊）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 爱好语法铁律：表达长期的兴趣爱好时，like / love / enjoy 后面紧跟【动词-ing】（like reading / swimming）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What are your hobbies, Zhang Peng?
dialogue.zh: 张鹏，你的业余爱好是什么呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I like playing football and singing English songs!
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢踢足球和唱英文歌！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds interesting!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真有意思！

dialogues.en: What's he like? — He's kind and funny.
dialogues.zh: 他是个什么样的人？（问性格外貌必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 考场极易混三剑客：What's he like? (问性格/外貌) · What does he like? (问喜好) · What does he do? (问职业)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We have a new PE teacher! What's he like?
dialogue.zh: 我们有一位新体育老师！他是个什么样的人呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: He is tall and strong. And he's very kind and funny!
dialogue.zh: 他又高又壮，而且既和蔼又风趣！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: He sounds nice!
dialogue.zh: 他听起来人真好！

dialogues.zh: 你爸爸是做什么工作的？（问职业必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 询问职业两大句型：What does he do? ＝ What is his job?（回答职业前必加冠词 a/an：He is a pilot.）。⚠️ What is he? 是老式说法，现在容易被听成“他是什么（东西）”，认得即可、自己不用。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What does your father do, Mike?
dialogue.zh: 迈克，你爸爸是做什么工作的呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: He is a pilot. He works on a big plane!
dialogue.zh: 他是一名飞行员。他在大飞机上工作！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Cool!
dialogue.zh: 真酷！

dialogues.en: Can you play ping-pong with me?
dialogues.zh: 你能和我一起打乒乓球吗？
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 play 的黄金冠词法则：球类棋类不加 the（play basketball/chess）；乐器必加 the（play the pipa/piano）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you play ping-pong with me after school?
dialogue.zh: 放学后你能和我一起打乒乓球吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure, I'd love to! Ping-pong is my favourite sport!
dialogue.zh: 当然，我很乐意！乒乓球是我最喜欢的运动！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Great! See you after school!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！放学后见！

dialogues.en: Would you like to be my pen pal?
dialogues.zh: 你愿意做我的笔友吗？
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 礼貌邀请必背答句：听到 Would you like to do sth.? 肯定回答最地道的是 Yes, I'd love to!（注意末尾保留 to）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We both like science and puzzles! Would you like to be my pen pal?
dialogue.zh: 我们都喜欢科学和拼图！你愿意成为我的笔友吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I'd love to! Here is my email address.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我非常乐意！这是我的电子邮箱地址。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Great! Let's write soon!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我们很快就开始通信吧！

dialogues.en: Keep in touch! Write to me soon!
dialogues.zh: 保持联系！尽快给我写信哦！（毕业与离别）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 毕业赠言三金句：Keep in touch! (保持联系) · Best wishes! (最美好的祝愿) · Good luck! (祝你好运)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We are going to middle school soon. Keep in touch!
dialogue.zh: 我们马上就要上初中了。保持联系哦！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure! I will write to you and call you often!
dialogue.zh: 一定会的！我会经常给你写信、打电话的！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Best wishes!
dialogue.zh: 祝你一切顺利！

dialogues.zh: 今天天气怎么样？（询问天气必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 询问天气双王牌：① What's the weather like?（有介词 like） ＝ ② How is the weather?（无 like）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What's the weather like in Beijing today?
dialogue.zh: 今天北京的天气怎么样呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's sunny and warm! Let's go to the park!
dialogue.zh: 今天晴朗又暖和！我们去公园玩吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.zh: 正在下雨呢！带上一把雨伞吧。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 雨天出行必备：Take an umbrella (带把伞) / Put on your raincoat (穿上雨衣)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Look outside! It's raining now. Take an umbrella with you!
dialogue.zh: 看外面！现在正在下雨呢。随身带上一把雨伞吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, Mum! I'll put on my rain boots, too.
dialogue.zh: 好的，妈妈！我还会穿上我的雨靴。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.en: Which season do you like best?
dialogues.zh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？（四季偏好必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 同义句转换必考：Which season do you like best? ＝ What's your favourite season?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which season do you like best, Amy?
dialogue.zh: 艾米，你最喜欢哪一个季节？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I like autumn best! Because the weather is cool and the leaves are golden.
dialogue.zh: 我最喜欢秋天！因为天气凉爽，树叶金黄。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.en: What day is it today? — It's Friday.
dialogues.zh: 今天星期几？— 今天星期五。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 时间三问精准区分：What day (问星期几) · What date (问几月几号) · What time (问几点几分)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What day is it today, John?
dialogue.zh: 约翰，今天是星期几呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's Friday! Tomorrow is the weekend!
dialogue.zh: 今天是星期五！明天就是周末啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.en: When is your birthday? — On May 1st.
dialogues.zh: 你的生日在什么时候？— 在五月一日。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 时间介词变身术：in May（在五月，大月份用 in） ➔ on May 1st（在五月一日，具体到某一天必用 on）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: When is your birthday, Mike?
dialogue.zh: 迈克，你的生日在什么时候呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: My birthday is on May 1st. Come to my birthday party!
dialogue.zh: 我的生日在五月一日。来参加我的生日派对吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Great! I'd love to come!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我很乐意来！

dialogues.en: What do you do on the weekend?
dialogues.zh: 你周末通常做什么？（日常习惯）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 两个 do 揭秘：What 【do】(助动词，无实义) you 【do】(实义动词“做”) on the weekend?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you usually do on the weekend, Sarah?
dialogue.zh: 萨拉，你周末通常做什么呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I often wash my clothes, read books and play sports in the park.
dialogue.zh: 我经常洗衣服、看书，还在公园里做运动。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.en: What are you going to do tomorrow?
dialogues.zh: 你明天打算做什么？（将来计划必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 一般将来时双引擎：be going to + 动词原形（早就计划好打算做） ＝ will + 动词原形（将要做）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What are you going to do tomorrow, Binbin?
dialogue.zh: 斌斌，你明天打算做什么呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm going to see a film and visit my grandparents!
dialogue.zh: 我打算去看一场电影，还要去看望我的爷爷奶奶！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.en: Where did you go last weekend?
dialogues.zh: 你上周末去了哪里？（过去经历必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 过去式不规则变化王：问句用原形 go（因为有 did），答句必须变过去式 went（go ➔ went）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Where did you go last weekend, John?
dialogue.zh: 约翰，你上周末去了哪里玩呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I went to a forest park and went camping with my family!
dialogue.zh: 我去了森林公园，还和家人一起去露营了！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.en: Let's go on a picnic in the park!
dialogues.zh: 我们去公园野餐吧！（春日出游）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 户外活动高频短语：go on a picnic (去野餐) · go swimming (去游泳) · go boating (去划船) · go hiking (去远足)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Spring is warm and sunny! Let's go on a picnic in the nature park!
dialogue.zh: 春天温暖又晴朗！我们去自然公园野餐吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sounds great! I'll bring some sandwiches and apples!
dialogue.zh: 听起来太棒了！我来带一些三明治和苹果！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.zh: 我们去外面堆雪人吧！（冬日玩雪）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 下雪天必背搭配：make a snowman（堆雪人）· play in the snow（在雪地里玩）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hooray! It's snowing heavily! Let's make a snowman outside!
dialogue.zh: 太好啦！外面下大雪啦！我们去外面堆雪人吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good idea! Let's put a carrot on its nose!
dialogue.zh: 好主意！我们把一根胡萝卜插在它的鼻子上吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.en: What time is it now? — It's 4:30.
dialogues.zh: 现在几点了？— 四点半了，该回家了。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 回家零介词铁律：go home（回家）/ get home（到家），因为 home 是地点副词，前面绝不加 to！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What time is it now, Amy?
dialogue.zh: 艾米，现在几点钟啦？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's four thirty. School is over. Time to go home!
dialogue.zh: 现在四点半了。放学啦，该回家了！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.zh: 你的暑假过得怎么样？（假期回顾）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 回顾过去体验王牌：How was your weekend / holiday / trip? ➔ It was great / wonderful / good!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Welcome back to school! How was your summer vacation?
dialogue.zh: 欢迎回校！你的暑假过得怎么样呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It was wonderful! I went to Sanya and swam in the blue sea!
dialogue.zh: 棒极了！我去了三亚，还在蔚蓝的大海里游了泳呢！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: That sounds great!
dialogue.zh: 听起来真棒！

dialogues.zh: 请按顺序轮流来！（游戏与游乐场秩序）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 公共秩序四大金句：Take turns (按顺序轮流) · Keep to the right (靠右行) · Talk quietly (小声说话) · Work quietly!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Everyone wants to play on the slide. Please take turns!
dialogue.zh: 每个人都想玩滑梯。请大家按顺序轮流来哦！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK! You go first, and I will go after you.
dialogue.zh: 好的！你先滑，我排在你后面。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.zh: 请靠右通行！（走廊与楼梯安全规则）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 方向名词活用：the right (右边) ↔ the left (左边)，走在哪一侧用 Keep to the right/left!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Don't run on the stairs, children! Keep to the right, please!
dialogue.zh: 孩子们，不要在楼梯上跑！请靠右通行！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, Miss White! Safety comes first!
dialogue.zh: 好的，怀特老师！安全第一！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.en: How tall are you? — I'm 1.65 metres tall.
dialogues.zh: 你有多高？— 我身高一米六五。
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 身高比较黄金句：How tall are you? ➔ I'm 1.65 metres. I'm taller than you!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How tall are you, Zhang Peng?
dialogue.zh: 张鹏，你身高多少呀？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm 1.65 metres tall. I'm a little taller than you!
dialogue.zh: 我身高1.65米。我比你高一点点哦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.zh: 我们一起来打扫教室吧！（班级大扫除）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 考场必辨双子星：Let's (= Let us 咱们大家一起做) ↔ Let me (让我自己一个人做，自告奋勇分工)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let's clean the classroom together!
dialogue.zh: 我们一起来打扫教室吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK! Let me clean the blackboard and windows!
dialogue.zh: 好呀！让我来擦黑板和窗户吧！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK. I understand.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。

dialogues.en: Look at me! I can swim fast!
dialogues.zh: 看我！我游得很快！（展示才艺必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 副词防坑王：fast（快地）和 high（高地：jump high）本身就是副词，后面绝对不能画蛇添足加 -ly！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Look at me, Sarah! I can swim like a fish!
dialogue.zh: 萨拉，看我！我能像小鱼一样游泳！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Wow, cool! You can swim so fast!
dialogue.zh: 哇，太酷了！你游得真快呀！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.zh: 干得漂亮！太棒了！（夸奖鼓励必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 夸奖别人三剑客：Well done! (干得好) · Good job! (做得棒) · You're super! (你太棒了) ➔ 回答 Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I finished all the word puzzles, Miss White!
dialogue.zh: 怀特老师，我完成了所有的单词拼图！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Well done, Amy! You did a really good job!
dialogue.zh: 干得漂亮，艾米！你完成得太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你！

dialogues.zh: 熟能生巧！（鼓励坚持练习的黄金谚语）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 小学必背三大谚语：① Practice makes perfect (熟能生巧) · ② An apple a day keeps the doctor away · ③ No pain, no gain!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Coach, I still can't play basketball well.
dialogue.zh: 教练，我篮球还是打得不够好。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Don't give up, Mike! Practice makes perfect!
dialogue.zh: 别放弃，迈克！熟能生巧，多练就完美啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.zh: 别放弃！再试一次！（运动拼搏必会）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 赛场助威黄金组合：Come on! (加油) · Don't give up! (别放弃) · Try again! (再试一次)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Oh no, I tripped on the rope again!
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，我又被跳绳绊倒了！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Don't give up, Lucy! Come on, try again!
dialogue.zh: 别放弃，露西！加油，再试一次！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你！

dialogues.zh: 祝贺你（们）！我们赢啦！（获胜欢呼）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 庆祝胜利必背：We won! (我们赢了) · Congratulations! (祝贺，永远带复数 -s) · I'm proud of you! (为你骄傲)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hooray! Our team won the football match!
dialogue.zh: 万岁！我们队赢下了这场足球比赛！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Congratulations, boys and girls! I'm so proud of you!
dialogue.zh: 祝贺你们，孩子们！我真为你们感到骄傲！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.en: Let's count from one to ten!
dialogues.zh: 我们从一数到十吧！（游戏热身口令）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 万能介词搭档：from... to...（从……到……：from one to ten / from morning to night / from school to home）！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you ready for morning exercises? Let's count from one to ten!
dialogue.zh: 准备好做早操了吗？我们一起从一数到十吧！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.en: Whose turn is it now? — It's my turn!
dialogues.zh: 现在轮到谁了？— 轮到我啦！
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 轮流做某事句型：Whose turn is it? (轮到谁了) ➔ It's my turn! (轮到我了) / It's your turn! (该你了)！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Whose turn is it to roll the dice now?
dialogue.zh: 现在轮到谁掷骰子啦？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's my turn! Watch me get a six!
dialogue.zh: 轮到我啦！看我掷出一个六点！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK! Let's try.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试。

dialogues.en: You are a great team player!
dialogues.zh: 你真是一名出色的团队伙伴！（合作赞美）
dialogues.usage_note: 🌟 团队合作满分金句：High five! (击掌庆祝) · Good teamwork! (配合得好) · You're a great team player!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thanks for passing the ball to me, John! We scored a goal!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你把球传给我，约翰！我们进球得分啦！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: High five! You are a great team player! Teamwork makes the dream work!
dialogue.zh: 击掌庆祝！你真是个超棒的团队好队友！团结合作让梦想成真！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你！

dialogues.zh: 非常感谢你！
dialogues.usage_note: 当别人帮了大忙时表达感激。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Here is your lost schoolbag!
dialogue.zh: 这是你弄丢的书包！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Oh! Thank you so much!
dialogue.zh: 噢！太感谢你了！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: You're welcome!
dialogue.zh: 不客气！

dialogues.zh: 我的荣幸（不客气）。
dialogues.usage_note: 礼貌回应感谢。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you for helping me.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你帮我。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: My pleasure!
dialogue.zh: 我的荣幸！

dialogues.zh: 对不起，我迟到了。
dialogues.usage_note: 进教室迟到时的致歉语。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'm sorry I'm late, Miss White.
dialogue.zh: 对不起怀特老师，我迟到了。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: That's all right. Come in, please.
dialogue.zh: 没关系，请进。

dialogues.en: Hello, my name is Chen Jie.
dialogues.zh: 你好，我的名字叫陈洁。
dialogues.usage_note: 正式自我介绍。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello, my name is Chen Jie. What's your name?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我叫陈洁。你叫什么名字？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Hi! My name is Sarah.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我叫萨拉。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you!
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你！

dialogues.zh: 我今年十岁了。
dialogues.usage_note: 介绍自己的年龄。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How old are you, Wu Binbin?
dialogue.zh: 吴斌斌，你几岁了？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm ten years old.
dialogue.zh: 我十岁了。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'm ten, too!
dialogue.zh: 我也十岁！

dialogues.en: I'm in Class Two, Grade Four.
dialogues.zh: 我在四年级二班。
dialogues.usage_note: 班级在前、年级在后。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which class are you in?
dialogue.zh: 你在哪个班？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm in Class Two, Grade Four.
dialogue.zh: 我在四年级二班。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We are in the same grade!
dialogue.zh: 我们在同一年级！

dialogues.zh: 请问你能帮帮我吗？
dialogues.usage_note: 用 Could 更委婉礼貌。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This box is heavy. Could you help me, please?
dialogue.zh: 箱子太重了，能帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure! Let's carry it together.
dialogue.zh: 当然！我们一起搬。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogues.zh: 我能借用一下你的词典吗？
dialogues.usage_note: 借入物品用 borrow。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, can I borrow your dictionary?
dialogue.zh: 能借用一下你的词典吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Of course! Here you are.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以！给你。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogues.zh: 这个单词是什么意思？
dialogues.usage_note: 请教生词意思。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Miss White, what does this word mean?
dialogue.zh: 怀特老师，这个词是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It means 'delicious'—yummy food!
dialogue.zh: 意思是美味的！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Aha! I got it!
dialogue.zh: 我明白啦！

dialogues.zh: 祝你生日快乐！
dialogues.usage_note: 生日祝福语。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Happy Birthday to you! Here's a gift.
dialogue.zh: 祝你生日快乐！这是礼物。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Wow, thank you!
dialogue.zh: 哇，谢谢你！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let's eat the cake!
dialogue.zh: 我们吃蛋糕吧！

dialogues.zh: 新年快乐！
dialogues.usage_note: 新年问候。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Happy New Year, Grandma!
dialogue.zh: 奶奶，新年快乐！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Happy New Year, dear!
dialogue.zh: 新年快乐宝贝！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogues.zh: 儿童节快乐！
dialogues.usage_note: 六一儿童节祝福。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Today is June 1st. Happy Children's Day!
dialogue.zh: 今天是六一，儿童节快乐！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Happy Children's Day!
dialogue.zh: 儿童节快乐！

dialogues.zh: 祝你旅途愉快！
dialogues.usage_note: 朋友旅行前的祝愿。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'm going to Kunming tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我明天要去昆明旅行。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Have a good trip!
dialogue.zh: 祝你旅途愉快！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogues.zh: 你也一样！（同喜同乐）
dialogues.usage_note: 回应节日或周末祝福：对方的祝福若是你我都适用的（Have a nice weekend、Happy New Year），可以原样回送 The same to you!。⚠️ 只属于对方一个人的日子（生日、获奖）不能回送，要说真话祝福（Happy birthday!）。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have a nice weekend, Mike!
dialogue.zh: 祝你周末愉快！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thank you! The same to you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！你也一样！

dialogues.zh: 请稍等（别挂断）。
dialogues.usage_note: 电话中请对方稍候。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: May I speak to Mum, please?
dialogue.zh: 请问可以和妈妈通话吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Hold on, please. She is in the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 请稍等，她在厨房。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: OK, thank you!
dialogue.zh: 好的谢谢！

dialogues.zh: 需要我捎个口信吗？
dialogues.usage_note: 电话留言礼貌用语。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Sorry, he isn't at home. Can I take a message?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉他不在家，要留口信吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, please tell him to call me back.
dialogue.zh: 请让他给我回电话。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Sure!
dialogue.zh: 好的！

dialogues.zh: 现在几点了？
dialogues.usage_note: 询问具体时刻。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, what time is it now?
dialogue.zh: 请问现在几点了？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's four thirty. Time to go home!
dialogue.zh: 四点半了，该回家啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let's go!
dialogue.zh: 走吧！

dialogues.zh: 今天是星期几？
dialogues.usage_note: What day 问星期几。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What day is it today?
dialogue.zh: 今天是星期几？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's Wednesday. We have PE today!
dialogue.zh: 星期三，今天有体育课！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hooray!
dialogue.zh: 太棒啦！

dialogues.zh: 今天是几月几号？
dialogues.usage_note: What's the date 问几月几号。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What's the date today?
dialogue.zh: 今天是几月几号？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's September 10th—Teachers' Day!
dialogue.zh: 九月十日教师节！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let's thank our teachers!
dialogue.zh: 去感谢老师吧！

dialogues.zh: 该睡觉啦！
dialogues.usage_note: 催促睡觉。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: It's nine o'clock. Time for bed!
dialogue.zh: 九点啦，该睡觉了！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: OK, Mum. Good night!
dialogue.zh: 好的妈妈，晚安！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Sweet dreams!
dialogue.zh: 好梦！

dialogues.zh: 别放弃！继续加油试一试！
dialogues.usage_note: 鼓励遇到困难的伙伴。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I can't ride this bike well.
dialogue.zh: 我骑不好自行车。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Don't give up! Keep trying!
dialogue.zh: 别放弃！继续试一试！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogues.zh: 你今天看起来太酷了！
dialogues.usage_note: 夸赞朋友穿搭或状态。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Look at my new blue jacket!
dialogue.zh: 看我的新蓝夹克！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Wow, you look so cool today!
dialogue.zh: 哇，你今天看起来太酷啦！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogues.zh: 熟能生巧！
dialogues.usage_note: 鼓励勤加练习。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Your English is so good!
dialogue.zh: 你英语真棒！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thanks! Practice makes perfect!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！熟能生巧嘛！

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll read every day too!
dialogue.zh: 我也要每天读！

dialogues.zh: 我为你感到骄傲！
dialogues.usage_note: 长辈或老师的表扬。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Mum, I cleaned my bedroom!
dialogue.zh: 妈妈，我打扫了卧室！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Well done! I'm proud of you!
dialogue.zh: 干得漂亮！我为你骄傲！

scene_qa.title: 1. 问路与指路导航
scene_qa.q: Excuse me, how can I get to the science museum?
scene_qa.a: Go straight and turn left at the bookstore.

scene_qa.title: 2. 医院看病问诊
scene_qa.q: What's wrong with you? / What's the matter?
scene_qa.a: I have a bad cold and a headache.

scene_qa.title: 3. 商店购物与询价
scene_qa.q: Can I help you? How much is this skirt?
scene_qa.a: Yes, please. It's eighty-five yuan. I'll take it!

scene_qa.title: 4. 餐厅点餐与喜好
scene_qa.q: What would you like to eat and drink?
scene_qa.a: I'd like some beef noodles and a cup of milk.

scene_qa.title: 5. 谈论天气与穿衣
scene_qa.q: What's the weather like in Beijing today?
scene_qa.a: It's sunny and warm. Put on your jacket!

scene_qa.title: 6. 询问星期与课程
scene_qa.q: What day is it today? What do you have on Mondays?
scene_qa.a: It's Monday. We have English, math and music.

scene_qa.title: 7. 询问日期与生日
scene_qa.q: When is your birthday? What's the date today?
scene_qa.a: My birthday is on June 1st. Today is May 20th.

scene_qa.title: 8. 谈论周末过去活动
scene_qa.q: What did you do last weekend? Did you do anything else?
scene_qa.a: I cleaned my room and visited my grandparents.

scene_qa.title: 9. 谈论假期将来计划
scene_qa.q: Where are you going this summer holiday?
scene_qa.a: I'm going to Sanya by plane to take pictures.

scene_qa.title: 10. 询问职业与工作地点
scene_qa.q: What does your father do? Where does he work?
scene_qa.a: He is a pilot. He works on a plane.

scene_qa.title: 11. 打电话专用语（绝不用 I am）
scene_qa.q: Hello, may I speak to Sarah, please?
scene_qa.a: This is Sarah speaking. Hold on, please!

scene_qa.title: 12. 道歉、致谢与礼貌回应
scene_qa.q: Thank you so much! / I'm sorry I'm late.
scene_qa.a: You're welcome! / That's all right. Come in!

chants.title: 🎵 be动词三剑客拍手歌
en_lines: I am, you are, is for he, she, it!
Singular 'is', plural 'are',
Past time 'was' and 'were' go far!
zh_lines: 我用 am，你用 are，is 连着他她它！
单数不可数全用 is，复数主语一律 are，
回到过去变身 was 和 were 走天下！

chants.title: 🎵 三单小尾巴警报歌
en_lines: He plays, she goes, it watches TV,
One person or thing, add -s with glee!
When 'does' comes out, drop the -s for me!
zh_lines: 他玩耍加 s，她去加 es，它看电视加 es，
单人单物作主语，动词加上小尾巴！
一旦助动 does 出场，尾巴立刻脱掉它！

chants.title: 🎵 时空漏斗 in / on / at 节奏歌
en_lines: IN the year, IN the month, IN the spring so bright,
ON Monday, ON my birthday, ON a snowy night,
AT seven, AT noon, AT the door just right!
zh_lines: 在某年、在某月、在春天用大漏斗 IN，
在周一、在生日、在雪夜具体某天用 ON，
在七点、在正午、在门口精确小点用 AT！

chants.title: 🎵 How 与 What 黄金分工歌
en_lines: WHAT is for nouns: What colour? What time?
HOW is for degree: How old? How fine?
What is it LIKE? How IS it today?
Understand the logic and say hooray!
zh_lines: What 是代词管名词：什么颜色？什么时间？
How 是副词探程度：多大年纪？多么晴朗？
句尾有 like 缺宾语用 What，直接问状态用 How！
搞懂底层原理再也不死记硬背！

chants.title: 🎵 现在进行时双人舞歌
en_lines: Look and listen! Right here, right now!
Be plus -ing, take a bow!
Drop silent 'e', double 'n' in run,
We are learning and having fun!
zh_lines: 看一看、听一听！就在此时此刻！
be 动词加上 ing，两个搭档缺一不可！
去掉不发音的 e，双写 run 的 n，
我们正在快乐学习！

chants.title: 🎵 过去时能量吸收歌
en_lines: Went and saw, ate and bought,
Yesterday's actions that we caught!
When DID or DIDN'T comes to stay,
Back to base form right away!
zh_lines: went 和 saw，ate 和 bought，
昨天的动作换上过去式新衣裳！
一旦 did 或 didn't 站出来，
后面的动词立刻变回原形！

chants.title: 🎵 代词变身礼服歌
en_lines: I before the verb, ME after the rest,
MY needs a noun, MINE stands alone best!
zh_lines: 动词前面穿主格 I，动词介词后面换宾格 me，
形物代 my 必带名词，名物代 mine 独自站句尾！

chants.title: 🎵 There be 与 have 双轨歌
en_lines: There is a book upon the shelf,
I have a pencil for myself!
Never say 'There have', keep the rule,
Closest noun guides 'is' or 'are' at school!
zh_lines: 书架上存在一本书用 There is，
我自己拥有一支铅笔用 I have！
绝不说 There have，
就近原则决定用 is 还是 are！
